recipes.title: Dan dan noodles
recipes.blurb: Spicy sesame-peanut sauce, crispy pork and greens

steps.text: Whisk peanut butter, 2 tbsp soy sauce, vinegar, chili crisp, sesame oil and 1/3 cup hot water in a big bowl.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil for the noodles.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high. Cook the pork until crisp and no pink is left (160°F), breaking it up.
Add the garlic and 1 tbsp soy sauce and stir 30 seconds.
Boil the noodles until tender, adding the bok choy for the last minute. Drain.
Toss the noodles and bok choy in the sauce, then top with pork and scallions.

recipes.title: Chicken lo mein
recipes.blurb: Soft egg noodles, chicken and crisp veggies in savory sauce

steps.text: Boil the noodles 2 minutes or as the package says, then drain and rinse.
Mix the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil and sugar in a cup.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat. Cook the chicken until browned and 165°F inside. Move to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, garlic, carrots and cabbage. Stir-fry until just tender.
Add the noodles, chicken, scallions and sauce. Toss until hot and coated.

recipes.title: Vegetable chow mein
recipes.blurb: Crispy-edged noodles with cabbage, carrots and mushrooms

steps.text: Cook the noodles in boiling water 2 minutes, drain, and pat dry.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over high heat. Fry the noodles until golden in spots. Remove.
Add 1 tbsp oil, mushrooms and carrots. Stir-fry until soft.
Add the cabbage and garlic and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce, oyster sauce and sesame oil. Return the noodles and toss.
Top with the scallions.

recipes.title: Cold sesame noodles
recipes.blurb: Chilled noodles in nutty sesame sauce, great make-ahead lunch

steps.text: Boil the noodles until tender, drain, and rinse under cold water.
Whisk the tahini, peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, sesame oil, chili crisp and garlic.
Whisk in 1/4 cup warm water until the sauce is smooth and pourable.
Toss the cold noodles with the sauce.
Top with cucumber and scallions. Serve cold or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Scallion oil noodles
recipes.blurb: Shanghai-style noodles in fragrant fried scallion oil

steps.text: Bring a pot of water to a boil for the noodles.
Heat the oil in a small pot over medium-low. Add scallions and fry slowly until deep golden and crisp.
Remove the scallions. Stir the soy sauces and sugar into the hot oil; it will sizzle.
Boil the noodles until tender, then drain.
Toss the noodles with the sauce and scallions.

recipes.title: Beef chow fun
recipes.blurb: Wide rice noodles, tender beef and bean sprouts, smoky and savory

steps.text: Toss the beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the cornstarch. Separate the noodles gently.
Mix the remaining soy sauce, dark soy and oyster sauce.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok on high. Sear the beef 1 minute, then remove.
Add 2 tbsp oil and the garlic, then the noodles. Toss gently until hot.
Add sprouts, scallions, beef and sauce. Toss 1 minute until glossy.

recipes.title: Zhajiang noodles
recipes.blurb: Noodles with savory fermented bean and pork sauce

steps.text: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium. Cook the pork until browned and no pink is left (160°F).
Add the garlic, bean sauce, soy sauce and sugar. Stir 1 minute.
Pour in the water and simmer until thick.
Boil the noodles until tender and drain.
Top the noodles with sauce, cucumber and sprouts.

recipes.title: Singapore noodles
recipes.blurb: Curry rice vermicelli with shrimp, egg and peppers

steps.text: Soak the noodles in hot water until pliable, then drain.
Scramble the eggs in 1 tbsp oil. Remove.
Heat 1 tbsp oil. Cook the shrimp until pink. Remove.
Add the last oil, pepper and cabbage. Stir-fry, then add the curry powder.
Add the noodles, soy sauce and sugar. Toss, then return the egg and shrimp with scallions.

recipes.title: Tomato egg noodles
recipes.blurb: Comforting homestyle noodles in tomato and egg sauce

steps.text: Scramble the eggs in 1 tbsp hot oil until barely set. Remove.
Add 1 tbsp oil and the tomatoes. Cook until they break down.
Stir in ketchup, sugar, soy sauce, salt and 1/2 cup water. Simmer.
Boil the noodles until tender, then drain.
Fold the eggs into the sauce, pour over noodles and add scallions.

recipes.title: Garlic butter noodles
recipes.blurb: Buttery garlic noodles with oyster sauce and parmesan

steps.text: Boil the spaghetti until al dente. Save 1/2 cup of the water, then drain.
Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-low. Cook the garlic until fragrant.
Stir in oyster sauce, soy sauce and sugar.
Add the noodles and a splash of pasta water. Toss until glossy.
Toss in the parmesan and scallions.

recipes.title: Yangzhou fried rice
recipes.blurb: Classic fried rice with shrimp, ham, egg and peas

steps.text: Break up any clumps in the cold rice.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok on high. Scramble the eggs until just set, then remove.
Add 1 tbsp oil and the shrimp. Cook until pink. Remove.
Add the last oil and the rice. Fry, pressing, until hot and a little crisp.
Add ham, peas, soy sauce and salt. Return eggs and shrimp. Finish with sesame oil and scallions.

recipes.title: Simple egg fried rice
recipes.blurb: The side-dish classic with eggs, scallions and soy

steps.text: Break up the cold rice with your fingers.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet on high. Add the eggs and scramble until just set.
Add the rest of the oil and scallion whites. Stir 30 seconds.
Add the rice and fry until hot and starting to crisp.
Stir in soy sauce, salt, pepper, sesame oil and scallion greens.

recipes.title: Chicken fried rice
recipes.blurb: Takeout-style rice with chicken, egg, peas and carrots

steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok on high. Cook the chicken until browned and 165°F inside. Remove.
Scramble the eggs in 1 tbsp oil and remove.
Add 1 tbsp oil, garlic and the peas and carrots. Stir 1 minute.
Add the rice and fry until hot, pressing it against the pan.
Return chicken and eggs. Add soy sauce, sesame oil and scallions and toss.

recipes.title: Shrimp fried rice
recipes.blurb: Juicy shrimp and garlicky rice, ready in 20 minutes

steps.text: Cook the shrimp in 1 tbsp hot oil until pink and 145°F. Remove.
Scramble the eggs in a little oil and remove.
Add the remaining oil and garlic. Stir 20 seconds.
Add rice and peas and fry until hot.
Return shrimp and eggs, add soy sauce, sesame oil and scallions, and toss.

recipes.title: Chicken congee
recipes.blurb: Silky rice porridge with ginger, scallions and shredded chicken

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear.
Combine rice, broth, chicken and ginger in a large pot. Bring to a boil.
Reduce to a low simmer, partly covered. Stir often so it does not stick.
Lift out the chicken (165°F inside) and shred it, discarding bones.
Return the chicken, season with salt, and thin with water if needed.
Serve with soy sauce, sesame oil, scallions and white pepper.

recipes.title: Chinese sausage rice
recipes.blurb: Rice-cooker style rice with sweet lap cheong and greens

steps.text: Rinse the rice and put it in a pot with the water.
Bring to a boil, then lay the sausage on top. Cover and cook on the lowest heat.
Mix the soy sauce, sugar and 1 tbsp water.
Rest the rice off heat, covered.
Pan-sear the bok choy in the oil until tender.
Fluff the rice and sausage, drizzle with sauce, top with scallions and serve with the greens.

recipes.title: Hainanese chicken and rice
recipes.blurb: Poached chicken with ginger-scallion sauce and fragrant rice

steps.text: Cover the chicken with water in a pot with half the ginger and scallions and 1 tsp salt. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and poach on low until a thigh reaches 165°F. Do not boil hard.
Move the chicken to ice water, then rest. Save 2.5 cups broth.
Fry the garlic in 1 tbsp oil, add the rice, then 2.5 cups broth. Cook covered on low.
Mince remaining ginger and scallions with 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp oil and sesame oil for the sauce.
Carve the chicken. Serve over rice with sauce, soy sauce and cucumber.

recipes.title: Beef fried rice
recipes.blurb: Savory rice with sliced steak, onion and egg

steps.text: Toss the beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce.
Heat 1 tbsp oil on high. Sear the beef 2 minutes. Remove.
Scramble the eggs in a little oil and remove.
Add the remaining oil, onion and garlic. Cook until soft.
Add the rice and fry until hot.
Return beef and eggs. Add remaining soy sauce, oyster sauce and scallions.

recipes.title: Vegetable fried rice
recipes.blurb: Colorful, kid-friendly fried rice loaded with veggies

steps.text: Scramble the eggs in 1 tbsp hot oil. Remove.
Add 1 tbsp oil, garlic, peas and carrots and broccoli. Stir-fry until bright and tender.
Add the last oil and the rice. Fry until hot.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil. Return eggs.
Top with scallions.

recipes.title: Steamed ginger chicken rice bowl
recipes.blurb: Steamed ginger-soy chicken over rice with greens

steps.text: Mix the chicken with soy sauce, wine, cornstarch and ginger. Marinate.
Spread the chicken in a heatproof dish. Set in a steamer over simmering water.
Cover and steam until 165°F inside.
Steam the bok choy in the same pot for the last 3 minutes.
Serve over rice with pan juices, sesame oil and scallions.

recipes.title: Beef and broccoli
recipes.blurb: Tender flank steak and broccoli in glossy garlic-soy sauce

steps.text: Start the rice following the package so it is ready at the end.
Toss the beef with 1 tbsp cornstarch. In a cup, stir the soy sauce, sugar, water and 1 tsp cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over high heat. Brown the beef in one layer, then move it to a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, the broccoli and 2 tbsp water. Cover and cook until bright green.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir for 30 seconds.
Put the beef back, pour in the sauce, and stir until thick and glossy, about 2 minutes.
Serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Kung pao chicken
recipes.blurb: Spicy-sweet chicken with peanuts and dried chiles

steps.text: Toss the chicken with the cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce. Mix the remaining soy sauce, wine, vinegar and sugar.
Heat the oil in a wok over high. Toast the chiles 30 seconds.
Add the chicken in one layer and cook until browned and 165°F inside.
Add garlic, ginger and scallions and stir 30 seconds.
Pour in the sauce and toss until glossy.
Fold in the peanuts and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Mapo tofu
recipes.blurb: Silky tofu in a tingly, spicy chili-bean sauce with pork

steps.text: Simmer the tofu in salted water to firm it up, then drain.
Cook the pork in the oil over medium-high until browned and no pink is left (160°F).
Add the doubanjiang, garlic and ginger. Stir until the oil turns red.
Pour in the broth and soy sauce. Add the tofu and simmer gently.
Stir the cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and add. Cook until thick.
Top with Sichuan pepper and scallions. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Tomato and egg stir-fry
recipes.blurb: Soft eggs and juicy tomatoes, the ultimate home-style dish

steps.text: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok on medium-high. Scramble the eggs until just set. Remove.
Add 1 tbsp oil and the tomatoes. Stir-fry until they release juice.
Stir in sugar and salt.
Return the eggs and fold gently for 30 seconds.
Finish with scallions and sesame oil. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Dry-fried green beans
recipes.blurb: Blistered green beans with garlic, pork and chili

steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok on high. Fry the beans, tossing, until blistered and wrinkled. Remove.
Add 1 tbsp oil and the pork. Cook until browned and no pink is left (160°F).
Add garlic, ginger, chiles and chili bean paste. Stir 30 seconds.
Return the beans with soy sauce and sugar. Toss 1 minute.

recipes.title: Cashew chicken
recipes.blurb: Chicken, peppers and crunchy cashews in a light brown sauce

steps.text: Toss the chicken with the cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce. Mix the remaining soy, oyster sauce, vinegar, sugar and 1/4 cup water.
Heat 1 tbsp oil on high. Cook the chicken until browned and 165°F inside. Remove.
Add the last oil, peppers and garlic. Stir-fry until crisp-tender.
Return the chicken, add the sauce and bubble until glossy.
Stir in the cashews. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Pepper steak with onions
recipes.blurb: Tender beef with bell peppers and onion in savory sauce

steps.text: Toss the beef with the cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce. Mix the rest of the soy, oyster sauce and broth.
Heat 1 tbsp oil on high. Sear the beef in one layer, then remove.
Add the last oil, peppers, onion and garlic. Stir-fry until crisp-tender.
Return the beef, pour in the sauce and simmer until thick.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Shrimp with snow peas
recipes.blurb: Quick garlicky shrimp and crisp snow peas

steps.text: Stir the soy sauce, wine, cornstarch and 2 tbsp water together.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok on high. Cook the shrimp until pink and 145°F. Remove.
Add 1 tbsp oil, garlic, ginger and the snow peas. Stir-fry until bright.
Return the shrimp, add the sauce and toss until glossy.
Finish with sesame oil and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Fish-fragrant eggplant
recipes.blurb: Tender eggplant in sweet, sour and spicy garlic sauce

steps.text: Mix the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, cornstarch and 1/3 cup water.
Heat 3 tbsp oil in a wok on medium-high. Fry the eggplant, tossing, until soft and browned.
Push aside. Add 1 tbsp oil, garlic, ginger and chili bean paste. Stir 30 seconds.
Pour in the sauce and toss until the eggplant is glazed.
Top with scallions and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Cumin lamb
recipes.blurb: Xinjiang-style lamb with toasted cumin, chiles and onion

steps.text: Toss the lamb with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Toast the cumin in a dry wok until fragrant, then grind coarsely.
Heat the oil on high. Sear the lamb in one layer until browned (145°F).
Add the onion, garlic and pepper flakes. Stir-fry until the onion softens.
Add the cumin, salt and scallions. Toss 30 seconds and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Pork potstickers
recipes.blurb: Pan-fried dumplings with crisp bottoms and juicy pork filling

steps.text: Toss the cabbage with the salt, wait, then squeeze out the water.
Mix pork, cabbage, scallions, ginger, soy sauce and sesame oil until sticky.
Put 1 tbsp filling on each wrapper, wet the edge, fold and pleat to seal.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a nonstick skillet. Place dumplings flat side down and brown.
Add 1/4 cup water and cover. Steam until the filling reaches 165°F.
Uncover and cook until the water is gone and bottoms are crisp.

recipes.title: Boiled pork and chive dumplings
recipes.blurb: Northern-style jiaozi with a juicy pork and chive filling

steps.text: Mix pork, chives, ginger, soy sauce, wine, sesame oil and salt in one direction until sticky.
Fill each wrapper with 1 tbsp filling, wet the edge, and pinch shut.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Boil in batches. Add a cup of cold water when they float. Repeat twice.
Check one dumpling reads 165°F inside.
Serve with vinegar and soy sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Chicken and cabbage dumplings
recipes.blurb: Light dumplings with chicken, cabbage and ginger

steps.text: Salt and squeeze the cabbage dry.
Mix chicken, cabbage, scallions, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil and cornstarch.
Fill and fold the wrappers, sealing the edges with water.
Brown the dumplings in oil over medium-high, flat side down.
Add 1/3 cup water, cover, and steam until 165°F inside.

recipes.title: Vegetable dumplings
recipes.blurb: Mushroom, cabbage and tofu dumplings, fully vegetarian

steps.text: Salt the cabbage, then squeeze out the water.
Mix cabbage, mushrooms, tofu, carrots, scallions, soy sauce, sesame oil and ginger.
Fill and pleat the dumplings.
Brown in oil over medium-high.
Add 1/3 cup water, cover, and steam until the wrappers are tender.

recipes.title: Wontons in chili oil
recipes.blurb: Silky pork wontons in sweet, tangy, spicy sauce

steps.text: Mix the pork, ginger, scallions, 1 tbsp soy sauce and the sesame oil.
Put a teaspoon of filling on each wrapper, fold into triangles, and seal.
Stir the chili crisp, 2 tbsp soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and garlic in bowls.
Boil the wontons until floating and cooked through (165°F).
Lift into the sauce, toss, and serve.

recipes.title: Steamed pork buns
recipes.blurb: Fluffy yeast buns filled with savory pork

steps.text: Mix flour, yeast, sugar and warm water into a dough. Knead until smooth. Cover and let rise.
Mix pork, soy sauce, sesame oil, oyster sauce, scallions and ginger.
Divide the dough into 8 balls. Roll flat, fill, and pleat shut.
Set buns on parchment squares in a steamer. Rest.
Steam over boiling water until puffed and pork is 165°F.

recipes.title: Scallion pancakes
recipes.blurb: Flaky, crisp pan-fried flatbread layered with scallions

steps.text: Stir the boiling water into the flour. Knead into a smooth dough. Rest.
Divide into 4 pieces. Roll each thin, brush with oil, and sprinkle salt and scallions.
Roll up into a log, coil into a spiral, and flatten with a rolling pin.
Fry each pancake in a hot oiled skillet until golden and crisp on both sides.
Cut into wedges. Dip in soy sauce and vinegar.

recipes.title: Crab rangoon
recipes.blurb: Crispy wonton cups with creamy crab and cream cheese

steps.text: Mix the cream cheese, crab, scallions, Worcestershire and garlic.
Put 1 tsp filling in each wrapper. Wet the edges, fold into triangles, and seal.
Heat the oil to 350°F in a skillet.
Fry in batches until golden and crisp.
Drain on paper towels. Serve with sweet chili sauce.

recipes.title: Pork egg rolls
recipes.blurb: Crunchy fried rolls with pork, cabbage and carrots

steps.text: Cook the pork in a skillet until no pink is left (160°F), then add the cabbage, carrots and garlic.
Stir in soy sauce and sesame oil. Cool completely.
Place filling on each wrapper, roll tightly, and seal with beaten egg.
Heat the oil to 350°F in a heavy pot.
Fry the rolls in batches until deep golden.
Drain on a rack and serve hot.

recipes.title: Wonton soup
recipes.blurb: Pork wontons in clear ginger chicken broth

steps.text: Mix the pork, ginger, scallions, 1 tbsp soy sauce and sesame oil.
Fill each wrapper with 1 tsp filling, fold, and seal with water.
Simmer the broth with the remaining soy sauce.
Add the wontons and bok choy. Cook until they float and reach 165°F.
Season with white pepper and serve.

recipes.title: Hot and sour soup
recipes.blurb: Peppery, tangy soup with tofu, mushrooms and egg ribbons

steps.text: Bring the broth, pork and mushrooms to a simmer.
Add the tofu, vinegar, soy sauce and white pepper. Simmer.
Stir the cornstarch with 1/4 cup cold water and stir in until thick.
Slowly drizzle in the eggs while stirring.
Check the pork is cooked through. Top with scallions.

recipes.title: Egg drop soup
recipes.blurb: Silky egg ribbons in savory ginger broth, ready in 10 minutes

steps.text: Simmer the broth with the ginger.
Stir the cornstarch with 3 tbsp cold water. Stir into the broth until lightly thick.
Slowly pour in the eggs in a thin stream while stirring.
Add salt and white pepper.
Top with scallions and sesame oil.

recipes.title: Chicken and sweet corn soup
recipes.blurb: Creamy-style soup with corn, chicken and egg ribbons

steps.text: Bring the broth and corn to a simmer.
Add the chicken and soy sauce.
Stir the cornstarch with 3 tbsp cold water, then stir in until thick.
Pour in the egg slowly while stirring.
Top with scallions and white pepper.

recipes.title: Braised beef noodle soup
recipes.blurb: Rich star anise beef broth with tender beef and noodles

steps.text: Brown the beef in oil in a Dutch oven, then remove.
Add garlic, ginger and doubanjiang. Stir 1 minute.
Return the beef with soy sauce, star anise and water. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer gently until the beef is very tender.
Boil the noodles and bok choy separately and drain.
Ladle beef and broth over noodles. Top with scallions.

recipes.title: Pork rib and daikon soup
recipes.blurb: Clear, soothing Cantonese soup with tender ribs and radish

steps.text: Cover the ribs with cold water, boil 5 minutes, then drain and rinse.
Put ribs, ginger and 8 cups water in a pot. Bring to a boil, then lower.
Simmer partly covered until the ribs are tender.
Add the daikon and simmer until translucent.
Season with salt, then serve with scallions.

recipes.title: Tofu and mushroom soup
recipes.blurb: Light, savory vegetarian soup with ginger and greens

steps.text: Simmer the broth with the ginger and mushrooms.
Add the tofu and soy sauce. Simmer gently.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Finish with sesame oil and scallions.

recipes.title: Ginger chicken soup
recipes.blurb: Comforting clear soup with chicken, ginger and goji berries

steps.text: Boil the chicken in water 3 minutes, drain and rinse.
Put the chicken, ginger, 6 cups water and wine in a pot. Bring to a boil.
Simmer gently until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Add goji berries and simmer.
Season with salt and top with scallions.

recipes.title: Seaweed egg drop soup
recipes.blurb: Quick soup with nori, egg ribbons and sesame

steps.text: Bring the broth and soy sauce to a simmer.
Add the nori and simmer until soft.
Stir the soup in a circle and pour in the eggs in a thin stream.
Finish with sesame oil, pepper and scallions.

recipes.title: Pork and napa cabbage soup
recipes.blurb: Meatball soup with soft napa cabbage and glass noodles

steps.text: Mix the pork, ginger, 1 tbsp soy sauce and cornstarch. Roll into small balls.
Bring the broth to a simmer and add the meatballs.
Add the cabbage and noodles. Simmer until tender; meatballs must reach 160°F.
Season with the remaining soy sauce.
Top with scallions.

recipes.title: General Tso's chicken
recipes.blurb: Crispy chicken in sweet, tangy, lightly spicy sauce

steps.text: Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, hoisin and 1/2 cup water for the sauce.
Toss the chicken in the cornstarch to coat.
Heat the oil to 350°F. Fry the chicken in batches until golden and 165°F inside.
Drain the oil, leaving 1 tbsp. Add garlic, ginger and chiles for 30 seconds.
Pour in the sauce and simmer until syrupy.
Toss the chicken in the sauce and serve with broccoli and rice.

recipes.title: Orange chicken
recipes.blurb: Crispy chicken coated in sticky orange sauce

steps.text: Dip the chicken in egg, then cornstarch.
Heat the oil to 350°F and fry the chicken in batches until golden and 165°F inside.
Simmer juice, soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, garlic and zest in a pan.
Stir 1 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and add until thick.
Toss the chicken in the sauce.

recipes.title: Sesame chicken
recipes.blurb: Crisp chicken in sweet-savory glaze with toasted sesame seeds

steps.text: Dip the chicken in egg, then cornstarch.
Fry in 350°F oil until golden and 165°F inside.
Stir honey, soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil and garlic in a pan.
Simmer the sauce until syrupy.
Toss the chicken in the sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Sweet and sour chicken
recipes.blurb: Crispy chicken with pineapple, peppers and tangy red sauce

steps.text: Dip the chicken in egg, then cornstarch.
Fry in 350°F oil until golden and 165°F inside.
Whisk ketchup, vinegar, sugar and 1/4 cup water.
Simmer the sauce with the peppers and pineapple.
Toss in the chicken and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Mongolian beef
recipes.blurb: Crisp-edged beef in savory sweet sauce with scallions

steps.text: Toss the beef in the cornstarch.
Heat the oil in a wok to 350°F. Fry the beef 1 minute, then drain.
Pour off all but 1 tbsp oil. Fry the garlic and ginger.
Add the soy sauce, water and sugar. Simmer until syrupy.
Return the beef and scallions and toss. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Egg foo young
recipes.blurb: Fluffy savory omelet patties in brown gravy

steps.text: Mix the eggs with the sprouts, shrimp or ham, and scallions.
Whisk the broth, soy sauce, oyster sauce and cornstarch in a pan. Simmer until thick.
Heat oil in a skillet. Pour in 1/3 cup batter per patty and cook.
Flip and cook until set.
Serve with gravy over rice.

recipes.title: Moo shu pork
recipes.blurb: Pork, cabbage and egg stir-fry in warm tortillas with hoisin

steps.text: Toss the pork with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Scramble the eggs in 1 tbsp oil. Remove.
Stir-fry the pork in 1 tbsp oil until 145°F inside. Remove.
Add 1 tbsp oil, cabbage, mushrooms and scallions. Stir-fry.
Return pork and eggs and toss.
Spread each tortilla with hoisin, fill and fold.

recipes.title: Honey walnut shrimp
recipes.blurb: Crispy shrimp in creamy honey sauce with candied walnuts

steps.text: Boil the walnuts 2 minutes, drain, and toss with sugar. Toast in a dry pan until golden.
Whisk the mayo, honey, condensed milk and lemon juice.
Toss the shrimp in cornstarch.
Fry in 350°F oil until golden and 145°F inside.
Toss the shrimp in the sauce and top with walnuts.

recipes.title: Lemon chicken
recipes.blurb: Crispy chicken cutlets with sweet lemon sauce

steps.text: Dip the chicken in egg, then cornstarch.
Fry in oil until golden and 165°F inside.
Simmer lemon juice, sugar and broth.
Stir 1 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and add until thick.
Slice the chicken and spoon on sauce with lemon slices.

recipes.title: Char siu BBQ pork
recipes.blurb: Sticky roasted pork with sweet red glaze

steps.text: Mix hoisin, honey, soy sauce, wine, sugar, garlic and five-spice. Marinate the pork overnight.
Heat the oven to 400°F and set the pork on a rack over a foil-lined pan.
Roast, brushing with marinade every 15 minutes.
Raise the heat to 450°F and cook until charred at the edges. Pork should read 145°F.
Rest, then slice and serve with rice.
